Ram Mandir donation case: Police investigate alleged irregularities

An investigation is underway into alleged irregularities concerning donations collected for the Ram Mandir. Police have recorded statements from former trust general secretary Champat Rai and are examining bank employees. The probe involves reviewing CCTV footage, cash seizures, and other evidence, with raids conducted on the homes of several accused individuals.
